rv.q: This is an entrancing journey through the genius of Sondheim.

Sondheim’s dry wit, deep emotional quotient, and laser sharp vision into the human condition is on full display in this intimate production of “Side by Side by Sondheim,” reminding us of the power and joy of storefront theater in (or just north of) our great city.
Moreover, some of the vocals are inconsistent and not every cast member is up to the demands Sondheim makes on his singers.
Side by Side by Sondheim at Oil Lamp Theater in Glenview is a joyous celebration of words and music that resonate as strongly today as when they were first written.
On the tech side of this sterling production, the set (Spencer Donovan) is simple, and never detracts from the words and music of the "master".

cn.t: Critics praise this Sondheim revue for showcasing the legendary composer's brilliant lyrics and memorable melodies with sincerity and vivid performances that honor his enduring theatrical legacy.
